description:
We went back to Springfield, Ohio, where Trump and Vance ignited a wave of hate in 2024.

Haitians are 25% of the town, and many now fear arrest and deportation, with one student even taking his own life.

And Springfield is not rebounding — it leads Ohio in job losses.

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Free online shopping returns used to be the norm — those days are over.

Online retailers have quietly started charging for returns, and they’re making nearly a billion dollars a year doing it.

They’re raking in money in part by hiding this fee from you until you need the service.

Host: @nikitadumptruck
Producers: Aisha Diop, Lucy Stockton, Victoria Hammett
Supervising producer: Court Fuller
Editor: @discosludge
DP: Jack Belisle
title: The $883 million secret behind the online shopping industry
